rationale: Archive Indian Energy from the PortCo census because neither BlackRock nor GIP held verified equity. The live record incorrectly converts an approximately US$25 million BlackRock Impact Opportunities bridge loan for the Viejas project into an active GEPIF III ownership period. A direct 2026 BlackRock Impact Opportunities interview describes the exposure as bridge capital that earned a return and had already been returned; Indian Energy's closing release identifies BlackRock Impact Opportunities as a financing partner rather than an equity owner. No GIP investment or asset-level transfer was found. The approved archive removes Indian Energy from the published and evaluated seed PortCo universe, ends the false active ownership attribution and retains the original mistaken relation only as corrected audit history rather than asserting a historical equity stake.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Archived PortCo-census record for Indian Energy, LLC, an active Native American-owned developer, integrator, owner and operator of resilient microgrids, renewable generation and energy storage. Indian Energy is a qualifying infrastructure operating company, but no direct BlackRock or GIP equity ownership was established. The relationship previously recorded as a BlackRock GEPIF III ownership period was instead an approximately US$25 million BlackRock Impact Opportunities bridge loan supporting the Viejas Enterprise Microgrid project. Indian Energy identified BlackRock Impact Opportunities as a financing partner at the September 2024 project financial close, and a direct 2026 BlackRock Impact Opportunities interview said the bridge capital had earned a return and been returned. A July 2024 tribal-government resolution separately disclosed a 15% direct Indian Energy interest held by the Sault Ste. Marie Tribe. The complete current cap table is not public, but the evidence is sufficient to exclude the company from the requested BlackRock and GIP PortCo lists. The record is archived rather than represented as a realized infrastructure-fund equity investment.
